entries.3cc3ea4939f9d0e4: It produces residential building materials such as sashes, doors, and exterior and interior products using raw materials such as aluminum profiles, new aluminum ingots and parts. The annual securities report states that the manufacturing strategy in its management policy pursues high-mix, low-volume production with short lead times that can also accommodate custom orders. Research and development is conducted on the themes of health, comfort and environmental harmony, and in the current fiscal year it also worked on research and development of new sashes. In the current fiscal year, the company wrote off part of the related assets recorded in construction in progress for the development of new sashes, as demand for them is not expected.

The securities report states that, aided by national government subsidy measures, the Company focused on expanding orders in this field in the fiscal year ended March 2026. The management policy states that in the renovation field, the Company will concentrate on expanding sales to major housing manufacturers. It also states that a construction department was newly established in the fiscal year and that personnel were increased to strengthen the Company's in-house capacity for renovation work.

entries.d6afec8282fd425d: It manufactures and sells residential building materials, and is a company with no consolidated subsidiaries (it does not prepare consolidated financial statements). As of March 31, 2026, it had 331 employees, and separately an annual average of 42 temporary employees, including part-time staff. Its principal facilities are listed as the Shiga Plant, Kanto Plant, Yamaguchi Plant, Shizuoka Plant, Tohoku Center and Ritto Resource Recycling Center (recycling treatment facility).
